name: C
note: Attempt C = B resumed from its population at gen ~412 (in the gusts + turbulence stage), with one change: the boulder stage ramps the boulder size from 40% to 100%. Why: the cloned start network only landed 25% with the boulder (pilot 77%) and B's best wind champion 14% (300 paired flights): the boulder skill was never cloned well, so it must be learned in NEAT, from small boulders up.

stages.name: calm
stages.expect: Quick: the cloned network already lands in calm air; NEAT polishes centring. Pass within ~30 generations.

stages.name: steady push
stages.expect: Lean into a constant push that grows from 5 to 15. The pilot lands ~84-90% here, so pass at 90%. Risk: landing off the pad downwind.

stages.name: gusts
stages.expect: Real gusts at full strength. The wind project's best NEAT reached ~91% with turbulence; aim 95% without.

stages.name: gusts + turbulence
stages.expect: The full wind task. Beat the earlier 91%.

stages.name: boulder
stages.expect: Starts near 14-25% landed with full-size boulders, so ramp the size 40% -> 100% over 150 generations. Expect the longest stage; a pass at 95% may need the polish stage too.

stages.name: polish
stages.expect: Everything on, only the env score + landing bonus. Pass = 98% on 100 + 100 fresh flights, then the 1,000-flight goal check.
